name: The village below the College of San José, Macau
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of a Tanka boat beached on the foreshore of the Inner Harbour, Macau; beyond is a row of village houses, backed by a high wall; above that is the domed seminary church of San José (St Joseph).

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
